title: Marcos to meet MILF leader Murad Ebrahim in November

blocks.text: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. is set to meet with Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF) chief Al Haj Murad Ebrahim in November, Malacañang said on Thursday, as Bangsamoro groups clamor for the Chief Executive to have a dialogue with the Mindanaoan leader before the end of the month.

why: headline only by design — this outlet blocks article pages
